query.description: Search query — what are you looking for?

n_results.description: Page size — number of hits per page (default: 5)

folder.description: Folder to restrict the search to. Includes all nested sub-folders automatically — pass 'bibel' to search both Schlachter and GuteNachricht, 'judaica' to search everything Jewish, 'bibel/Schlachter' to narrow to one translation. Omit to search all documents; the Bible and Judaica corpora need their folder.

page.description: 1-based page number. page=1 (default) returns the best hits, page=2 the next batch deeper into the ranking, etc. Use the SAME query; fetch a next page only when the response contains a next_page_hint.
